about: How Whalyom improves and updates itself. Owner-only file: the evolution loop reads it and never edits it. mode "auto-safe": verified knowledge, briefs and benchmarked agent rules apply automatically inside the limits below; "propose": everything waits for the owner (node tools/evolve.mjs apply <id> --owner). External skills and connectors always wait for the owner. Protected paths can never be changed by the loop. New agents (kind new-agent) ship only within agents.new_agents: web tools only, sonnet or haiku, installed skills only, backed by active knowledge facts and a passed red team, and each one rolls back with evolve.mjs rollback <id>.
